stem: How did Chavez accomplish the change referred to in this excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: By promoting military service as an opportunity for minority youths

options.label: B
options.text: By filing legal cases to overturn segregation in public facilities

options.label: C
options.text: By organizing an economic boycott to improve working conditions for migrant farmers

options.label: D
options.text: By protesting fines imposed on employers for hiring illegal immigrants

visual_elements:
With few material possessions, but guided by his parents' steady example, his Catholic faith, the lessons of Gandhi, and an unshakable belief in justice, Cesar Chavez brought about much needed change in our country.

—Medal of Freedom citation awarded posthumously to Cesar Chavez, August 1994
